reviews.review:
fairly low-spec. i can run this on my laptop with no problem. the later levels could start to get a little frustrating if you picked up the "charge in the enemies' face and hack away with your chansword/poweraxe/power hammer" style of play. when I started fighting chaos space marines, they deal so much damage so quickly i had to hide behind cover and game the shooting mechanics to shoot enemies through cover. 

The story is pretty good, but there is no character development. There is you, the veteran dude that can use all the weapons. There is the old guy that's the grizzled grunt and the young 'un that wont shut up about the codex astartes as if it was penned and handed down to him by the God Emperor himself.

Surprised to find multiplayer was not dead, Got into some co-op games, which worked pretty good. Killing Orks with friends could be really fun, if killing Orks with strangers is anything to go by. Haven't played any PVP yet, and not really feeling PVP in this game anyway.
Ork killing goodness all the way!  FOR THE EMPEROR!

The game (for me) is a big and great success of Warhammer 40k games, i mostly liked the animations of all melee weapons attacks, the single player is kinda challenging due to the difficulty you choose espcially the bosses, exterminatus (Co-op againts Orks/Chaos) there's is nothing to say fun is the only word i can say to that, but there is one thing bothers me in pvp witch is the Host Margrating thing (Peer To Peer) it's like some guy playing in a random country with high ping makes my game more laggy and more hard to kill or even move, so i really hope they'l change that in the future (i sure hope so) The games is totally worth 30 dollars i recommend this game for 100% espcially if you're a Warhammer 40k fan. HAVE FUN!!!

This game needs a sequel, one of the best 40k games.

If you like the Warhammer Universe and you have 5.- $$$/EUR(Next Steam Sale). You can have a short fun with this Konsoleros Game.

5 / 10 Points...
